meta.title: PNG to JPG Converter - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Convert PNG images to JPG format instantly in your browser. No upload required, 100% private.
formatAutoDetected: Format is auto-detected — no need to select manually
anyFormatDesc: Drop a PNG, JPG, WebP, SVG, AVIF, or HEIC image and convert it to any supported output. You don't need to match the current page.
tooManyConversions: Too many conversions. Please wait a moment.
steps_png-to-jpg_1Desc: Select your PNG image by clicking the upload area or dragging it onto the page. Your file stays entirely on your device throughout the process.
steps_png-to-jpg_2Desc: Set the output JPEG quality — higher values preserve more detail but increase file size. The default of 92% provides an excellent balance.
steps_png-to-jpg_3Desc: Click Convert to transform your PNG into a JPEG. The converted image downloads automatically — your original PNG remains untouched.
desc: Convert PNG images to JPG format instantly in your browser. No upload required, 100% private.
avifEncodeFailed: Your browser does not support AVIF encoding. Please choose another output format.
